```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r loading mapping stat files}
DOX_ChIP_samplenames <- read_delim("C:/Users/renee/Other_projects_data/DOX_CHIP/DOX_ChIP_samplenames.txt", 
    delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
    trim_ws = TRUE)

final_Peak_counts <- read_delim("C:/Users/renee/Other_projects_data/DOX_CHIP/final_Peak_counts.tsv", 
    delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
    trim_ws = TRUE) 


tidy_peak_counts <- final_Peak_counts %>% 
 tidyr::extract(file,  into = c("Sample", "Tx", "Ab", "Individual", "qval"),
    regex = "^(.*)_(VEH|DOX)_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_(q[^_]+)_peaks\\.narrowPeak$") 

  

```

```{r, tidy peaks, fig.height=8, fig.width=5}
pd <- position_dodge(0.75)

tidy_peak_counts %>% 
   mutate(Tx=factor(Tx, levels = c("VEH","DOX")),
           Ab=factor(Ab, levels = c("TOP2B","p53","CTCF","RAD21"))) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=Tx,y= peak_count))+
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=Tx),position = pd) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Individual, group = Tx),
             position = pd, size = 2)+
 facet_grid(Ab~qval, scales="free",drop = TRUE)+
# facet_wrap(~ Ab + qval, scales = "free_y", drop = TRUE)+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold",  hjust = 0, size = 8),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linetype = "solid",
                                        color = "black", linewidth = 1),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, 'points'),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  ggtitle("Peak call number by q value")

tidy_peak_counts %>% 
  pivot_wider(., id_cols = c(Sample:Individual), names_from = "qval",values_from = "peak_count") %>% 
kableExtra::kable(.,caption = "Peak counts for DOX ChIP") %>% 
   kableExtra::kable_paper("striped", full_width = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, font_size = 14) %>% 
  kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")
```
